profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Schonfeld
profile.geoLocationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary: several years of experience in the financial sector. Proven leadership abilities and a track record of producing innovative ideas, which have proven successful in implementing them. Skilled in project planning with ability to successfully manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously while meeting deadlines for every day work. Strong interpersonal skills enabling effective communication at all levels within an organization. I can also provide excellent customer service by working well as part of a team or on my own initiative

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Stevens Institute of technology is the one of the oldest private institute of technology in the United States. Stevens Institute of technology was listed among the top innovative I.T. schools and has been ranked among the best Engineering Graduate Schools in the nation.

Roles & Responsibilities
Maintain 20 scheduled office hours per week and answer student queries regarding class requirements, concepts.
Compose, administer, and promptly grade quizzes, exams, or other instruments of evaluation throughout the semester so that each student in the class is aware of his/her progress or level of performance
Assist students in completing capstone projects by providing technical advice including reviewing code, performance analysis, simulating interest.
Conducting class and review capstone projects with team to emphasize course content also direct students to additional resources based on need of a projects.		 

Environment: C, C++, Java 1.5, .Net, SQL, MYSQL, Linux, Multithreading and Shell scripting.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
A developer of indoor golf simulator. The simulator will give golfers the chance to test their accuracy and driving skills in a simulation. This virtual golfing system provides customers with several of the world's best golf courses.

Roles & Responsibilities
Wrote and executed test plans and test cases for testing of applications with golf simulator hardware.
Design detailed test cases for new features and future regressions.
Use QA tools to run automated tests and work with development engineers to have manual tests become automated tests for future regressions.
Test Software and Hardware signal Integrity applications, using Robotic equipment.
Calibrate and test the entire golf jockey, cameras, touch screens and replay cameras.
Work closely with installation team to provide onsite support and calibration. Provide training of the product to 3rd party support person and demo to users.
  
Environment: Linux, Shell scripting.

positions.title: Software Programmer
positions.description:
Arvind International is an India's one of the top textile companies exporting textile worldwide which has largest portfolio of International brands: Lee, Wrangler, Nautica, Jansport, Tommy, Arrow, US Polo, Izod etc.

Roles & Responsibilities
Developed Cash Flow System, Product Cost Estimation using D2k, Oracle 8i and Report 6i.
Performed requirements analysis, design, and development and testing of the systems.
Cash Flow System: - Designed, developed and tested a cash flow system as per the company standards. Provided facilities to manage cash flow among different divisions, search particular data and generate reports.
Product Cost Estimation:- Designed, developed and tested systems that determined pricing of any company product of any developmental stage. Featured a user-friendly interface and government formatted print outs.

Environment: D2k, Oracle, SQL, Report 6i, Crystal Report.
